# Web research

Use this skill whenever the user asks about current events, prices, versions or anything that changes over time.

1. Search first, answer second. Never answer from memory for time-sensitive facts.
2. Prefer primary sources (official docs, changelog, vendor status page) over blog summaries.
3. When sources disagree, say so and give both numbers.
4. Always include the source URL next to the claim it supports.
5. If a page cannot be read, say which source failed instead of guessing.
